title: Adoption Cuebook & Competitor Signal Lab for Model Landscape Tracking
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational "Adoption Cuebook" and lightweight 'Signal Lab' that continuously collects, normalizes, and prioritizes low-latency indicators of competitor model releases, regional availability, quantization adoption, and enterprise adoption signals. This will power alerting for PM/GTMs and feed a model-compatibility inventory. Deliverables: (1) taxonomy of signals with sources and scoring rules, (2) ETL spec and mock dataset, (3) a Looker/Metabase prototype dashboard with 6 core widgets, (4) runbook for probing model behavior (probe query set + evaluation heuristics), and (5) integration plan to surface top-3 risks to sales and runtime teams.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy documented with >=12 signal sources and scoring rules
Prototype dashboard shows time-series for availability, latency delta, and quant adoption by region
ETL pipeline spec + sample mock payloads reviewed by ENG
Probe set (50 queries) validated against 3 model vendors with basic metrics (accuracy proxy, hallucination rate, token-cost delta)
Rollout runbook created and handed off to Solutions Eng for a pilot customer
comments: 2026-01-20 Aisha: Kickoff meeting with PM, Research, and Solutions Eng. Agreed scope and success metrics. Confluence stub created.

2026-01-27 Liam: Initial signal inventory draft completed. Found reliable public indicators for model releases (GitHub tags, model hub RSS, vendor release notes) and paid sources (vendor feeds). Added 'quantization hint' as a derived signal from model artifact sizes.

2026-02-03 Research: Ran a two-week probe against 4 open models using a 50-query probe set. Noted that short-context latency varies significantly by quantization; added 'quant-lag' metric to taxonomy.
2026-02-18 Eng feedback (I. Chen): Prefer event-driven collection (webhooks + publisher-subscribers) rather than polling for scalable costs. ENG-20482 assigned to prototype the collector.

2026-02-25 PM review (N. Rodriguez): Suggested prioritization matrix to surface 'adoption-ready' signals vs 'noise'. Added business impact column (migration risk, procurement risk, feature parity) to taxonomy.

2026-03-02 Liam: Prototype dashboard wired to mock ETL. 6 widgets implemented: Release cadence heatmap, Regional availability map, Quant adoption trend, Latency delta by model, Enterprise mention velocity (LinkedIn/GitHub), and Probe-set regression tracker.

2026-03-04 Design review (S. Park): UX critique — make alerts digestible (email + Slack + Console banner) and add one-click drilldowns to relevant PR/Confluence doc. Action: add acceptance test for drilldown links.
2026-03-05 Aisha: Ready for pilot with Solutions Eng. Created a pilot checklist and scheduled handoff. Next: finalize ETL contract and onboard ENG-20482 for collector MVP. Linked artifacts below.
notes: Open question: threshold tuning for 'migration risk' — propose A/B test with two pilot accounts to tune sensitivity.
We should avoid vendor-specific parsing rules in the core; keep adapter layer pluggable.
Estimate assumes ENG will provide a simple webhook ingestion endpoint; if polling required, effort doubles.
